items.title: Adobe (ADBE) Joins Open Source AI Cybersecurity Alliance As AI Trust Takes Focus
items.summary: Adobe joined an industry coalition to create the Open Source AI Cybersecurity Alliance, focusing on safer AI tools and standards. The alliance aims to develop shared, open-source defenses for AI systems that are increasingly used across software and digital media. This move adds a new dimension to Adobe's role in AI beyond its core creative and productivity products.
